improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace for business owners and traders. Powered by Claude. Try free, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value prop and pricing upfront. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for a B2B audience. Including the free trial and low entry price reduces friction and encourages clicks.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant), who it's for (trade and business professionals), and the key benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading includes a clear, low-friction CTA by highlighting the three free searches, reducing hesitation and encouraging trial engagement without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be prompted to select a membership plan to continue. Choose from US$2 or US$7 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. Your membership unlocks unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, workspace tools, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model: what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition and immediately reinforcing value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces uncertainty and positions the upgrade as a natural next step rather than a barrier.
